existingFixParts.note: XR821244 is the genuine Jaguar differential output/assembly seal, fits 2003-2009 (both LH and RH output). A leaking near-side output seal is the classic early tell; replacing it promptly preserves the unit. Cheap consumable - buy two (both sides).

existingFixParts.note: Jaguar-spec fill for the X150 XK non-LSD rear diff is 75W-140 synthetic to M2C 192A (Castrol BOT 720, JLR C2D3650). Capacity ~1.9-2.0 L; no drain plug on the standard diff - extract via fill port. Required whenever the diff/seals are serviced. Price is per liter; need ~2 L.
